records.name: Custom LLM - Synchronize prompts
records.description: Dry run by default. Empty capability selection covers all qualified Now LLM Generic capabilities. Adds Custom LLM prompt variants without changing skill selection.

localConfigurationSeeds.name: custom_llm.prompt_mirror.default_model
localConfigurationSeeds.description: Local sys_generative_ai_model_config sys_id of the desired Custom LLM mirror standard. Required; no first-active or hardcoded-model fallback. Configure separately on each target instance.

localConfigurationSeeds.name: custom_llm.prompt_mirror.automation_enabled
localConfigurationSeeds.description: Enable source prompt after-insert/update reconciliation after local model and native write contract validation.

localConfigurationSeeds.name: custom_llm.prompt_mirror.apply_enabled
localConfigurationSeeds.description: Allow product metadata writes after a successful native dry run. Dry runs remain available while false.

localConfigurationSeeds.name: custom_llm.prompt_mirror.serialized_execution_verified
localConfigurationSeeds.description: Set true after independently validating deterministic insert-only claim collision/release behavior and normal target writes. Revision checks alone are not atomic.

configurationProvisioning: Four private local settings are configured on the target through the normal admin UI; their Update Set import is not guaranteed. No runtime property state or property fallback.

nativeDefinitionConfigContract.sourceCardinality: Exactly one source definition configuration; otherwise block before writing.
nativeDefinitionConfigContract.generation: Installed native after-insert rule creates the target child; read and verify its actual sys_id, parent, capability, ownership and nondefault status before recording an origin. Never insert a duplicate configuration or write its readonly capability.
nativeDefinitionConfigContract.promptBindings: Exactly one source binding per source prompt is currently supported. Native prompt insertion generates its target binding; verify its real ID and calculated readonly definition, then update only filter_properties/filter_type/is_default/order. Ambiguous source cardinality blocks before writes.
nativeDefinitionConfigContract.inputs: Installed native GenAIPreprocessor reads inputs by capability. Read all capability input records as unchanged hash-verified dependencies; never duplicate or write their readonly legacy definition. Input changes fan out through capability to qualified source definitions.
nativeDefinitionConfigContract.compatibility: Unknown native generator recipes or readonly dictionary contracts block safely until reviewed for that platform version.
nativeDefinitionConfigContract.selection: Retain native generated active=true/default=false and all existing AI Control Tower provider selections; only enable_large_input_support and sys_overrides are eligible option writes.
nativeDefinitionConfigContract.ownership: When native newRecord.package is empty, infer persisted package only in the natively proven Global context after reading matching current sys_scope and sys_package records. Never assign ownership fields.
nativeDefinitionConfigContract.aliases: Definition connection follows provider mapping; selected model retains its separate HTTP connection alias. Read and fingerprint both independently.
